digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 37
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Jorrick Models publishes a small code model
items.summary: Jorrick Models publishes a small code model with open weights. The weights ship under a permissive licence.
items.whyItMatters: Teams can run it on their own hardware.

items.title: Marlowe Mesh supports multi-cluster failover
items.summary: Marlowe Mesh supports multi-cluster failover for internal services. Traffic moves to a healthy cluster when health checks fail.
items.whyItMatters: Service outages stay inside one cluster.

items.title: Stoneleigh Eval adds a hosted judge
items.summary: Stoneleigh Eval adds a hosted judge service, now stable. Teams can score model outputs against their own rubric.
items.whyItMatters: Teams can score outputs without running a judge model.

sources.title: Jorrick Models publishes a small code model
sources.summary: Jorrick Models publishes a small code model with open weights. The weights ship under a permissive licence. A fill-in-the-middle mode is included for editor completion.

sources.title: Marlowe Mesh supports multi-cluster failover
sources.summary: Marlowe Mesh supports multi-cluster failover for internal services. Traffic moves to a healthy cluster when health checks fail. Failover events are exported as metrics.

sources.title: Stoneleigh Eval adds a hosted judge
sources.summary: Stoneleigh Eval adds a hosted judge service in beta. Teams can score model outputs against their own rubric. The beta is free until the end of the year.
